description:
Translates audio into English.

This endpoint supports only `whisper-1`. The endpoint and model are deprecated
and scheduled to shut down on February 26, 2027. Migrate to
`/v1/realtime/translations`, which requires a separate integration. See the
[deprecation schedule](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations)
for details.

400.description: Invalid audio input or request parameters.

schema.description: JSON-encoded error text containing an error object and the HTTP status.

401.description: Authentication failed because the API key is missing or revoked, or the client IP is not authorized.

schema.description: JSON-encoded error text containing an error object and the HTTP status.

403.description: Access to a personal API organization is blocked by the organization policy.

413.description: The audio request exceeds the supported size limit.

500.description: The audio could not be processed.

502.description: The upstream audio service connection failed.

file.description: The audio file object (not file name) translate, in one of these formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, or webm. The request must include enough format metadata for the file to be identified. We recommend an extension-bearing filename and an appropriate content type.

model.description: ID of the model to use. Only `whisper-1` (which is powered by our open source Whisper V2 model) is currently available.

prompt.description: An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The [prompt](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/speech-to-text#prompting) should be in English.

response_format.description: The format of the output, in one of these options: `json`, `text`, `srt`, `verbose_json`, or `vtt`.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. If set to 0, the model will use [log probability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log_probability) to automatically increase the temperature until certain thresholds are hit.

duration.description: The duration of the input audio.

language.description: The language of the output translation (always `english`).

segments.description: Segments of the translated text and their corresponding details.

avg_logprob.description: Average logprob of the segment. If the value is lower than -1, consider the logprobs failed.

compression_ratio.description: Compression ratio of the segment. If the value is greater than 2.4, consider the compression failed.

end.description: End time of the segment in seconds.

no_speech_prob.description: Probability of no speech in the segment. If the value is higher than 1.0 and the `avg_logprob` is below -1, consider this segment silent.

start.description: Start time of the segment in seconds.

temperature.description: Temperature parameter used for generating the segment.

tokens.description: Array of token IDs for the text content.

detailed_explanation.description: The public explanation for this block.

error_type.description: An optional classification; clients must accept additional values.

anyOf.description: An opaque target for explicitly continuing this review, or null when unavailable.

error.message: Your request rate increased too quickly. Please reduce the request rate and gradually increase it again.

InferenceRateLimited.description: The request was rejected because a rate limit was exceeded. A slow_down error means traffic increased too quickly; reduce your request rate, then increase it gradually.

Retry-After.description: The minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying. This header is returned when the server has computed a retry delay and may be omitted.

serverOverloaded.summary: The requested model is temporarily overloaded

error.message: The model is temporarily overloaded. Please retry your request after a brief delay.

InferenceServiceUnavailable.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. A server_is_overloaded error means the requested model is temporarily overloaded; retry after a brief delay.

Retry-After.description: The minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying. This header is returned when the server has computed a retry delay and may be omitted.
